literatureGoals.population: 40 shoulders of 20 volunteers without shoulder problems
literatureGoals.citation: Namdari S, Yagnik G, Ebaugh DD, Nagda S, Ramsey ML, Williams GR, Mehta S. Defining functional shoulder range of motion for activities of daily living. J Shoulder Elbow Surg. 2012;21(9):1177-1183. Ten daily tasks needed 128 +/- 7.9 deg of abduction; the authors still call full motion a reasonable goal.

notes: Front view keeps abduction in the image plane. Shoulder abduction = interior angle between the trunk (shoulder to hip) and the upper arm, so arm at the side is about 0.
